description: This file contains service functions for managing chatflows, including creation, retrieval, validation, deletion, and configuration handling within a chat application backend.

methods.name: validateChatflowType
methods.description: Validates if the provided chatflow type is among the allowed enum values.

methods.name: checkIfChatflowIsValidForStreaming
methods.description: Checks if a chatflow is valid for streaming based on its configuration and flow structure.

methods.name: checkIfChatflowValidForUploads
methods.description: Checks if a chatflow is valid for uploads by retrieving its upload configuration.

methods.name: deleteChatflow
methods.description: Deletes a chatflow and associated data, including messages, feedback, history, and storage.

methods.name: getAllChatflows
methods.description: Retrieves a list of chatflows with optional filtering by type and pagination.

methods.name: getAllChatflowsCountByOrganization
methods.description: Counts chatflows of a specific type within an organization.

methods.name: getAllChatflowsCount
methods.description: Counts total chatflows, optionally filtered by type and workspace.

methods.name: getChatflowByApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves chatflows associated with a specific API key.

methods.name: getChatflowById
methods.description: Fetches a chatflow by its ID, optionally within a specific workspace.

methods.name: saveChatflow
methods.description: Creates a new chatflow, handling base64 file uploads and telemetry reporting.

methods.name: updateChatflow
methods.description: Updates an existing chatflow, including handling file path updates and validation.

methods.name: getSinglePublicChatbotConfig
methods.description: Retrieves public configuration for a chatflow, including chatbot config and upload settings.

methods.name: checkIfChatflowHasChanged
methods.description: Checks if a chatflow has been modified since a given timestamp.

methods.name: _checkAndUpdateDocumentStoreUsage
methods.description: Updates document store usage based on nodes in the flow data.
